title: 384-Well Plate Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the desired protocol parameters in the provided fields of the OT App interface.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the custom labware files (with .json extension) to upload.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Protocol tab in the OT App and upload the protocol script file (with .py extension).

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware according to the provided deck map for up to nine 384‑well plates.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette as instructed; refer to support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to start the 384‑well plate preparation.
